cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: A man came in after looking at a shop to rent. Didn't take it. Said all the metal shelves leaned towards one bit of wall, even the one they moved out into the middle.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: Agent told him subsidence. He asked why the bottles on the counter were standing straight. Didn't get an answer he liked.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: We had something like that near my uncle's old shop once, where he had a physics vein. Had to keep the stock on the other side. Not saying this is that, shelving can just be bad shelving.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: I've sent you the address, and a photo from the estate agent listing. The wall on the right, he said.
You save the location. The letting photograph shows the shelves empty.
